description: Verify one exact package version and symbol against its official commit. Never substitutes another version.

package.description: Use the PyPI name shown in the coverage tool, such as requests. Do not enter a repository URL.

symbol.description: Use the exact symbol identifier in list_coverage, such as request or AsyncClient.__init__. Do not enter a file path.

version.description: The exact release to verify, such as 2.33.0. Do not use a range or latest.

name: resolve_exact_version
